# Recommended Implementation Approach

Implement a **copy-on-write or immutable data structure pattern** that creates a defensive copy of the original data before any modifications, ensuring the original remains unmodified while maintaining a clean audit trail of all changes. This approach satisfies the non-modification constraint [ctx_view_0001], supports auditability [ctx_view_0003], and aligns with the explored implementation options [ctx_view_0002]. Document all state transitions in an immutable change log to provide complete traceability for compliance and debugging purposes.
